N2.byte_matching_scope: Equal total accepted wire bytes via actual expert-tail DMA/pool padding; per-tile layout/A placement and phase timing are not identical, so this is not pure arithmetic isolation
N2.cold_metric: Routed Me<=2 rows / (last cold completion - first cold binding); queueing included, equal descriptor populations required
N2.onchip_focus: Real mixed T=96, Shared Me>=16; frozen source population is correlated across layers
N2.primary_busy_metric: Sum of mutually exclusive C1+C4+C5+C6+C7 across cores; per-core values are diagnostics of placement as well as service
